theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_cfs_counting_mellin_continuation
theorems.statement: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (κ α : ℝ), (∀ n : ℕ, 0 ≤ a n) → 0 ≤ α → α < 1 → (∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, a k) - κ * (n : ℝ)| ≤ C * (n : ℝ) ^ α) → ∃ H : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ H {s : ℂ | α < s.re} ∧ ∀ s : ℂ, 1 < s.re → LSeries (fun n : ℕ => (a n : ℂ)) s = (κ : ℂ) / (s - 1) + H s
theorems.natural_summary: Combines the accepted floor-remainder and Mellin-tail lemmas with mathlib's Abel integral formula, constructing H(s) = κ + sI(s) and separating the prescribed pole.
